ways.label: South Face Track from Woolshed Creek car park

end.name: Sharplin Falls car park
end.quote: Sharplin Falls car park is at the end of Flynns Road, Staveley.

via.name: junction of the Mount Somers summit hike
via.quote: the junction of the Mount Somers summit hike

evidence: From Woolshed Creek car park, cross Woolshed Creek and climb steeply up a rocky ridge.
The track then travels around the southern face of Mount Somers through a mix of open grassland and forest.
The final steep downhill section is through regenerating forest areas but is open enough to continue to provide interesting views to the east.
If you intend to walk only one way from Woolshed Creek car park and require vehicle transport, a local service is available

doubts: The description never names where the track ends; the end is taken as Sharplin Falls car park only because 'Getting there' lists it alongside Woolshed Creek car park and F1 is where the South Face Track meets Flynns Road. No feature in the packet is at Woolshed Creek car park (Jig Road end), so the start has no ref. Acland Shelter is a day shelter 'not intended to be used overnight', so it is not listed as a hut. The junction with the summit hike is a via point without its own ref.
